# Hole Spacing

Gap from a hole to the next hole or the edge of its face.

<figure markdown="span">
![Hole Spacing: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-hole-edge-distance-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Hole Spacing: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-hole-edge-distance-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Gap from a hole to the next hole or the edge of its face, against the wall or hole diameter.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 2.0× wall or hole Ø (larger) | 1.0× wall or hole Ø (larger) | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Crowded Hole (`{measured}`): `{feature}`, `{size}`, is closer than the recommended `{target}` `{reference}`. The narrow strip of material fills poorly and leaves a weak knit line. Move the hole further from the edge or from its neighbour.
!!! failure "Error"

    Hole Too Close (`{measured}`): `{feature}`, `{size}`, is under `{limit}` `{reference}`. The thin strip of material fills last, leaves a weak knit line and can crack when a screw or pin goes in. Leave at least `{target}` `{reference}` around the hole.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
| `{nominal}` | The nominal wall and where it came from, such as "2.40 mm (measured)" |
| `{reference}` | What the gap is compared with: the nominal wall or the hole's diameter |
